historicalNativeChatgptDetection.explanation: The captured imperative requests were transcribed but the ChatGPT route started no question jobs. Runtime sets semantic_intent only for Codex. The ChatGPT fallback requires interrogative score >=4 or an existing related question; these imperative openings do not qualify. Consequently these native cases did not reach the failing answer POST.
historicalNativeChatgptDetection.scope: Observed on these exact cases, not every ChatGPT question or every speech style. The ChatGPT topic-switch source was eventually played after the recorder wait expired; it did not interrupt a streaming ChatGPT answer because none existed.
